card.name: Words leading into emergency resuscitation steps
card.fires_on: Small words (begin, administer, standard, as, to, in) just before an expected resuscitation or rescue term, in overdose, cardiac arrest or emergency-readiness instructions.

modes.label: Start CPR
modes.description: Verb right before CPR in a list of emergency assessment steps.
modes.example: Evaluate airway, breathing, and circulation, and<< begin>> CPR if necessary.

modes.label: Overdose reversal
modes.description: Word before an overdose reversal agent or antagonist response.
modes.example: to opioid overdose,<< administer>> an opioid overdose reversal agent such as nal

modes.label: Cardiac arrest measures
modes.description: Word before resuscitative measures after a cardiac arrest statement.
modes.example: If cardiac arrest should occur,<< standard>> cardiopulmonary resuscitative measures

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words meaning CPR, resuscitation and rescue.
card.plain: It fires on the word just before the text names CPR or resuscitation in emergency instructions.
